ambiguities.fragment: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic
ambiguities.explanation: The term 'switches' is polysemous; it can function as a noun (the device itself) or a verb (the action of changing). This creates two distinct interpretations regarding whether the device performs the filtering or if the device's capability is being altered.
possible_interpretations: The routing switch (noun) has the ability to filter network traffic.
The routing switch (verb) changes its ability to filter network traffic.
textual_evidence: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic
